name: Amanzoe
insider_take: Perched like an ancient acropolis above the Argolic Gulf, Amanzoe is where Grecian mythology meets barefoot luxury — a sanctuary of pavilions, plunge pools, and perfect silence.
whats_special: Acropolis-Inspired Architecture: Designed by Ed Tuttle, Amanzoe's colonnaded pavilions and pool villas echo the grandeur of classical Greek temples, set dramatically on a hill in the Porto Heli region. Private Beach Club: A dedicated beach club shuttle whisks guests to Amanzoe's exclusive seaside retreat on the crystal-clear Aegean, complete with private cabanas and water sports. Aman Spa: One of the most celebrated spas in the Aman portfolio, featuring an expansive hydrotherapy circuit, yoga pavilion, and holistic treatments rooted in ancient Greek wellness traditions. Cultural Proximity: Situated just a short drive from the ancient theater of Epidaurus — one of the best-preserved theatres in the world — and the storied ruins of Mycenae.
pro_tip: Book a private sunset cruise from the Beach Club through Amanzoe's concierge — the views of the Argolic Gulf as the sun dips below the Peloponnese coastline are absolutely unforgettable, and the experience feels entirely your own.
dont_miss: Epidaurus by Night: Between June and August, the ancient theater of Epidaurus hosts world-class performances. Ask the concierge to arrange tickets — the acoustics are legendary and the setting surreal. Greek Cooking Journey: Join an Amanzoe-curated culinary experience exploring local olive groves, markets, and hands-on cooking with fresh Peloponnesian ingredients. Pool Pavilion Mornings: Wake up early and claim your private pool pavilion terrace before the Aegean sun climbs — the stillness, the olive-draped hillsides, and the Gulf views are pure magic.
pros: Stunning hilltop location with panoramic views of the Peloponnese coastline
Exceptional spa and wellness facilities with world-class treatments
Impeccable service and attention to detail characteristic of Aman properties
Luxurious pavilions and villas with private pools and terraces
cons: Remote location requires transportation to nearby attractions
